summary: This study looks at a special tea drink to see how it affects people with hyperlipidemias, which means having high levels of fats in the blood. The trial involves 129 participants who will try the tea, a standard medicine, or a low-fat diet. The First Affiliated Hospital with Nanjing Medical University is sponsoring this research. The trial has an Unknown status and is listed under the phase No phase.

facts.sponsor: The First Affiliated Hospital with Nanjing Medical University
